description: Deep load-following (20-100%) with faster ramp rates (~5%/min) and thermal inertia model

unit.name: Generic 540 MWth / 180 MWe Integral PWR SMR (NuScale VOYGR-class)
unit.source: IAEA (2022). Advances in SMR Technology Developments; NuScale VOYGR DCA (2020); Ingersoll & Carelli (2020) Handbook of Small Modular Nuclear Reactors

P_thermal_mw.note: Reactor module thermal power at full load

ramp_rate_limit_pct_min.note: Maximum allowed power ramp rate; SMRs designed for fast load-following (vs PWR 5%/min, BWR 1%/min, same as PWR but deeper range)

PLR_min.note: Minimum stable PLR for SMR (designed for deep load-following, down to 20%)

total_reactivity_margin_pcm.note: Total control rod reactivity margin (SMR designed with higher margin to enable deep load-following)

xenon_reactivity_coeff_pcm.note: Reactivity penalty at equilibrium Xe at full power (smaller core, lower burnup -> smaller Xe worth)

thermal_time_constant_min.note: Primary coolant thermal inertia time constant; integral design with no separate steam generator -> faster thermal response than large PWR

primary_cp_mj_per_k.note: Total primary loop heat capacity (integrated: water mass * cp); governs temperature transient during ramp

T_outlet_rated_c.note: Primary coolant hot-leg temperature at full power
